title: Footer at the bottom
summary: A column layout with flex: 1 on main keeps the footer down on short pages.
explanation: The page is a flex column at least as tall as the viewport. main has flex: 1, so it grows to fill whatever height the header and footer leave.
When content is longer than the viewport, main simply grows and the footer follows it: no positioning involved.
tryThis: Add lots of text to main and watch the page grow.
